title: clinopodium chinense var. urticifolium
intro: Clinopodium chinense var. urticifolium, commonly known as Wild Chrysanthemum, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Wild Chrysanthemum include expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for coughs, colds, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
